_doc: FRB G.19 Consumer Credit release calendar, CONFIGURED. DATES AND TIME from the Board's own statistical release calendar feed https://www.federalreserve.gov/data/statcalendar.json (the data behind https://www.federalreserve.gov/data/releaseschedule.htm; every G.19 row reads '3:00 p.m.'), cross-checked against the OMB PFEI 2026 page 4 'Consumer Credit' row (Jan 8 ... Dec 7, identical) and, for past rows, against the G.19 release archive https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/g19/releaseDates.json (identical 2025-01..2026-09). A release carries the SECOND month before its release month ('Data are issued about the fifth working day of the month for second month previous' -- PFEI; release 2026-09-08 = July 2026, G.19 current page). Rows: [date_ET, period_label]. Re-import each year from statcalendar.json (coverage ends 2026-12-31 -> NO_EXPECTATION after, by design).
